entries.prompt: All expense reports must be submitted _____ Friday to receive reimbursement this month.
entries.promptZh: 所有費用報告必須在星期五以前提交，才能於本月收到報銷。
entries.explanation: by 表示「不晚於某時間」，適合截止期限。

entries.prompt: Ms. Huang is responsible _____ training newly hired employees.
entries.promptZh: 黃小姐負責訓練新進員工。
entries.explanation: be responsible for 是「負責……」的固定搭配。

entries.prompt: Many customers are interested _____ the company's new membership program.
entries.promptZh: 許多顧客對公司的新會員方案有興趣。
entries.explanation: be interested in 是固定搭配。

entries.prompt: The new software is capable of _____ large amounts of data.
entries.promptZh: 這套新軟體能處理大量資料。
entries.explanation: 介系詞 of 後接名詞或 V-ing，因此選 processing。

entries.prompt: Ms. Patel _____ director of operations since last January.
entries.promptZh: Patel 女士自去年一月起一直擔任營運主管。
entries.explanation: since + 過去時間點常搭配現在完成式。

entries.prompt: The outdoor event was canceled _____ heavy rain.
entries.promptZh: 戶外活動因大雨而取消。
entries.explanation: because of 後接名詞片語；because 後面要接完整子句。

entries.prompt: The downtown branch will remain open, _____ the airport branch will close early.
entries.promptZh: 市中心分店會維持營業，相對地機場分店將提早關閉。
entries.explanation: whereas 用來對比兩個子句。

entries.prompt: The consultant was _____ recommended by several former clients.
entries.promptZh: 這位顧問受到多名前客戶的高度推薦。
entries.explanation: 修飾過去分詞 recommended 應使用副詞 highly。

entries.prompt: The company expects online sales to _____ significantly next quarter.
entries.promptZh: 公司預期下一季網路銷售將大幅增加。
entries.explanation: expect + O + to V；to 後接原形動詞。

entries.prompt: Applicants _____ have at least three years of experience will be given priority.
entries.promptZh: 具備至少三年經驗的申請者將優先錄取。
entries.explanation: 先行詞 applicants 是人，且關係代名詞在子句中作主詞，用 who。

entries.prompt: The shipment will arrive on time _____ the weather becomes severe.
entries.promptZh: 除非天候轉差，貨物將準時抵達。
entries.explanation: unless = if not，語意為「除非天氣惡化」。

entries.prompt: _____ several delays, the construction project was completed within budget.
entries.promptZh: 儘管多次延誤，工程仍在預算內完成。
entries.explanation: Despite 後接名詞片語 several delays。

entries.prompt: Final _____ from the finance department is required before the purchase can be made.
entries.promptZh: 完成採購前，需要財務部門的最終核准。
entries.explanation: 形容詞 final 後需接名詞 approval。

entries.prompt: The new filing system allows employees to locate documents more _____.
entries.promptZh: 新的歸檔系統讓員工能更有效率地找到文件。
entries.explanation: 修飾動詞 locate 應用副詞 efficiently。

entries.prompt: The orientation session is scheduled _____ at 9:30 A.M.
entries.promptZh: 新生訓練預定上午九點半開始。
entries.explanation: be scheduled to V 表示「預定做……」。

entries.prompt: Either the sales manager or her assistants _____ attending the trade show.
entries.promptZh: 銷售經理或她的助理們將出席商展。
entries.explanation: either A or B 的動詞通常與較近主詞 assistants 一致，用 are。

entries.prompt: Neither the printer nor the copy machines _____ functioning properly.
entries.promptZh: 印表機與影印機目前都無法正常運作。
entries.explanation: 較近主詞 copy machines 為複數，因此用 are。

entries.prompt: The seminar will cover not only customer service but also _____ management.
entries.promptZh: 研討會不只涵蓋客服，也會談時間管理。
entries.explanation: not only A but also B 要平行；customer service 與 time management 都是名詞片語。

entries.prompt: Additional information _____ available on the company's website.
entries.promptZh: 更多資訊可在公司網站取得。
entries.explanation: information 是不可數名詞，視為單數。

entries.prompt: By the time the manager arrived, the interview panel _____ the final candidate.
entries.promptZh: 經理抵達時，面試小組早已選定最後一位候選人。
entries.explanation: 較早發生的過去動作使用過去完成式。

entries.prompt: The company installed energy-efficient lighting _____ electricity costs.
entries.promptZh: 公司安裝節能照明以降低電費。
entries.explanation: 不定詞可表示目的：「為了降低」。

entries.prompt: _____ the quarterly report, Mr. Diaz sent it to the board members.
entries.promptZh: 完成季度報告後，Diaz 先生將它寄給董事會成員。
entries.explanation: 先完成報告再寄出，用 having + p.p. 表示先發生。

entries.prompt: The updated policy, _____ was announced yesterday, takes effect immediately.
entries.promptZh: 昨天公布的更新政策立即生效。
entries.explanation: 先行詞 policy 是物，非限定關係子句用 which。

entries.prompt: Customers _____ orders were damaged will receive replacements at no charge.
entries.promptZh: 訂單受損的顧客將免費收到替換品。
entries.explanation: whose 表示所有關係：「顧客的訂單」。

entries.prompt: The annual meeting, at _____ shareholders vote on major proposals, will be held in June.
entries.promptZh: 股東將對重大提案投票的年度會議將於六月舉行。
entries.explanation: at which = at the meeting，正式書面用法。

entries.prompt: If I _____ in charge of the project, I would revise the schedule.
entries.promptZh: 如果我是專案負責人，我會修改時程。
entries.explanation: 與現在事實相反的假設，be 動詞正式用 were。

entries.prompt: _____ we known about the road closure, we would have taken another route.
entries.promptZh: 如果早知道道路封閉，我們就會走另一條路。
entries.explanation: 先還原為 If we had known about the road closure。省略 if 後，將 had 移到主詞 we 前面，形成 Had we known；這是與過去事實相反的條件倒裝。

entries.prompt: All applications must _____ electronically through the company portal.
entries.promptZh: 所有申請必須透過公司入口網站以電子方式提交。
entries.explanation: 申請文件是被提交，因此用 must be submitted。

entries.prompt: Of the three candidates interviewed, Ms. Walker was the _____ qualified.
entries.promptZh: 三名受訪候選人中，Walker 女士最符合資格。
entries.explanation: 三者以上比較使用最高級 most qualified。

entries.prompt: The new procedure requires _____ steps than the previous one.
entries.promptZh: 新流程比舊流程需要更少步驟。
entries.explanation: steps 是可數複數，使用 fewer。

entries.prompt: There is very _____ time left before the registration deadline.
entries.promptZh: 距離報名截止時間只剩很少時間。
entries.explanation: time 是不可數名詞，使用 little。

entries.prompt: The first printer is out of order, so please use _____ one.
entries.promptZh: 第一台印表機故障，請使用另一台。
entries.explanation: another + 單數名詞，表示「另一個」。

entries.prompt: Each of the conference participants _____ a name badge.
entries.promptZh: 每位與會者都會收到名牌。
entries.explanation: each 作主詞時視為單數。

entries.prompt: The survey received _____ responses from overseas customers.
entries.promptZh: 這項調查收到許多海外顧客的回覆。
entries.explanation: responses 為可數複數，用 many。

entries.prompt: No personal calls are permitted _____ working hours.
entries.promptZh: 工作時間內禁止私人通話。
entries.explanation: during + 名詞片語 working hours。

entries.prompt: Please return the signed agreement _____ ten business days.
entries.promptZh: 請在十個工作天內交回已簽署的協議。
entries.explanation: within 表示「在某段期間之內」。

entries.prompt: _____ the weather forecast, the storm should pass by noon.
entries.promptZh: 根據天氣預報，暴風雨應在中午前通過。
entries.explanation: according to 表示「根據……」。

entries.prompt: _____ the base salary, employees receive transportation allowances.
entries.promptZh: 除基本薪資外，員工也會收到交通津貼。
entries.explanation: in addition to + 名詞，表示「除了……之外還有」。

entries.prompt: The company revised its policy _____ customer feedback.
entries.promptZh: 公司因應顧客回饋修改政策。
entries.explanation: in response to 表示「回應、因應」。

entries.prompt: Ms. Reed accepted the award _____ the entire design team.
entries.promptZh: Reed 女士代表整個設計團隊領獎。
entries.explanation: on behalf of 表示「代表……」。

entries.prompt: Full-time employees are eligible _____ health insurance benefits.
entries.promptZh: 全職員工有資格享有健康保險福利。
entries.explanation: be eligible for 是「有資格獲得……」。

entries.prompt: Are you familiar _____ the updated reservation system?
entries.promptZh: 你熟悉更新後的預約系統嗎？
entries.explanation: 人 be familiar with 物，表示熟悉某物。

entries.prompt: This model is similar _____ the one released last year.
entries.promptZh: 這款型號與去年推出的款式相似。
entries.explanation: be similar to 是固定搭配。

entries.prompt: Management is aware _____ the technical issue and is working on a solution.
entries.promptZh: 管理層已知悉技術問題，正著手解決。
entries.explanation: be aware of 是固定搭配。

entries.prompt: Most clients were satisfied _____ the revised proposal.
entries.promptZh: 大多數客戶對修訂後的提案感到滿意。
entries.explanation: be satisfied with 是固定搭配。

entries.prompt: The delay was due _____ an unexpected equipment failure.
entries.promptZh: 延誤是由突發設備故障造成。
entries.explanation: be due to 表示「由於」。

entries.prompt: The store will remain open _____ the renovation work.
entries.promptZh: 商店不受裝修工程影響，仍會營業。
entries.explanation: regardless of 表示「不論、不受……影響」。

entries.prompt: All visitors must register at the front desk prior _____ entering the laboratory.
entries.promptZh: 所有訪客進入實驗室前都必須在櫃台登記。
entries.explanation: prior to + N/V-ing，表示「在……之前」。

entries.prompt: The committee has not decided _____ the event will be held indoors or outdoors.
entries.promptZh: 委員會尚未決定活動要在室內或室外舉行。
entries.explanation: whether...or... 表示「是否……或……」。

entries.prompt: The instructions were rewritten _____ new users could understand them more easily.
entries.promptZh: 說明已重新撰寫，以便新使用者更容易理解。
entries.explanation: so that + 子句，表示目的。

entries.prompt: The purchasing manager will _____ with several suppliers before signing a contract.
entries.promptZh: 採購經理會先與數家供應商協商，再簽訂合約。
entries.explanation: negotiate with 表示「與……協商」。

entries.prompt: Because the speaker became ill, the seminar had to be _____.
entries.promptZh: 由於講者生病，研討會必須延期。
entries.explanation: postpone 表示延期；被延期用 be postponed。

entries.prompt: The warehouse manager checks the _____ every Friday to prevent shortages.
entries.promptZh: 倉庫經理每週五檢查庫存，以避免短缺。
entries.explanation: inventory 指庫存。

entries.prompt: Employees should attach receipts when requesting travel _____.
entries.promptZh: 員工申請差旅費報銷時應附上收據。
entries.explanation: travel reimbursement 指差旅費報銷。

entries.prompt: The laptop comes with a two-year _____ covering parts and labor.
entries.promptZh: 這台筆電附兩年零件與人工保固。
entries.explanation: warranty 指產品保固。

entries.prompt: The customer called to ask when her _____ would arrive.
entries.promptZh: 顧客來電詢問她的貨物何時送達。
entries.explanation: shipment 指一批運送中的貨物。

entries.prompt: The technology firm plans to _____ a smaller competitor.
entries.promptZh: 這家科技公司計畫收購一家規模較小的競爭者。
entries.explanation: acquire a company 表示收購公司。

entries.prompt: The company's annual _____ increased by twelve percent.
entries.promptZh: 公司的年度營收增加了百分之十二。
entries.explanation: revenue 指公司營收。

entries.prompt: Each _____ must submit a résumé and two references.
entries.promptZh: 每位應徵者都必須提交履歷與兩封推薦資料。
entries.explanation: applicant 指申請者、應徵者。

entries.prompt: Visitors can pick up a product _____ at the information desk.
entries.promptZh: 訪客可在服務台索取產品簡介。
entries.explanation: brochure 指介紹產品或服務的小冊子。

entries.prompt: Employees are encouraged to become familiar _____ the new safety procedures.
entries.promptZh: 員工被鼓勵熟悉新的安全程序。
entries.explanation: become/be familiar with 是「熟悉……」。

entries.prompt: The committee is committed to _____ energy consumption by ten percent.
entries.promptZh: 委員會致力於將能源消耗降低百分之十。
entries.explanation: be committed to 中的 to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing。

entries.prompt: Ms. Flores is accustomed to _____ with international clients.
entries.promptZh: Flores 女士習慣與國際客戶合作。
entries.explanation: be accustomed to 的 to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing。

entries.prompt: All visitors are required _____ a temporary identification badge.
entries.promptZh: 所有訪客都必須佩戴臨時識別證。
entries.explanation: be required to V。

entries.prompt: Demand for the new service is likely _____ during the holiday season.
entries.promptZh: 新服務的需求很可能在假期期間增加。
entries.explanation: be likely to V 表示「很可能……」。

entries.prompt: The revised contract is different _____ the version we reviewed last week.
entries.promptZh: 修訂後的合約與上週審查的版本不同。
entries.explanation: be different from 是標準固定搭配。

entries.prompt: The conference fee is inclusive _____ lunch and printed materials.
entries.promptZh: 會議費用包含午餐與印刷資料。
entries.explanation: be inclusive of 表示「包含……」。

entries.prompt: Please read the installation instructions _____ before operating the equipment.
entries.promptZh: 操作設備前請仔細閱讀安裝說明。
entries.explanation: 修飾動詞 read，使用副詞 carefully。

entries.prompt: The manager praised the team for its _____ response to the customer complaint.
entries.promptZh: 經理稱讚團隊迅速回應顧客投訴。
entries.explanation: 修飾名詞 response，用形容詞 prompt。

entries.prompt: A list of approved vendors _____ available from the purchasing department.
entries.promptZh: 核准供應商名單可向採購部門索取。
entries.explanation: 主詞中心字為單數 list，不受 vendors 影響。

entries.prompt: The factory _____ the components are assembled operates around the clock.
entries.promptZh: 組裝零件的工廠全天候運作。
entries.explanation: 先行詞 factory 是地點，子句缺地點副詞，用 where。

entries.prompt: The consultant to _____ we sent the financial records will arrive tomorrow.
entries.promptZh: 我們寄送財務紀錄給他的那位顧問將於明天抵達。
entries.explanation: 介系詞 to 後指人，正式用 whom。

entries.prompt: Not until the final inspection _____ the building open to the public.
entries.promptZh: 直到最終檢查完成後，建築才對外開放。
entries.explanation: 先還原正常語序：The building was open to the public only after the final inspection。Not until 置首後，主句的 be 動詞移到主詞前，成為 was the building open。空格後已經有主詞 the building，因此 was it 會形成 it the building 的雙主詞錯誤。

entries.prompt: _____ near the main entrance, the information desk is easy to find.
entries.promptZh: 服務台位於正門附近，很容易找到。
entries.explanation: information desk 與 locate 為被動關係，用過去分詞 located。

entries.prompt: The company _____ three new branches so far this year.
entries.promptZh: 公司今年到目前為止已開設三家新分店。
entries.explanation: so far this year 常搭配現在完成式。

entries.prompt: By the end of June, the construction crew _____ the roof repairs.
entries.promptZh: 到六月底，施工團隊將已完成屋頂修繕。
entries.explanation: by + 未來時間點，強調屆時完成，用未來完成式。

entries.prompt: The new delivery system is considerably _____ than the previous one.
entries.promptZh: 新的配送系統比先前的可靠得多。
entries.explanation: than 前使用比較級 more reliable。

entries.prompt: Employees may choose the training session that best fits _____ schedule.
entries.promptZh: 員工可以選擇最符合自己行程的訓練課程。
entries.explanation: 名詞 schedule 前用所有格形容詞 their。

entries.prompt: The product received excellent reviews; _____, sales remained below expectations.
entries.promptZh: 產品獲得極佳評價；然而銷售仍低於預期。
entries.explanation: 前後語意轉折，使用 however。

entries.prompt: The board decided to _____ additional funds to employee training.
entries.promptZh: 董事會決定撥出額外資金用於員工訓練。
entries.explanation: allocate funds to 表示將資金分配給某用途。

entries.prompt: The training manual is divided _____ five sections.
entries.promptZh: 這本訓練手冊分成五個部分。
entries.explanation: divide A into B 表示把 A 分成 B。

entries.prompt: The proposed schedule is acceptable _____ all department managers.
entries.promptZh: 所提時程為所有部門經理所接受。
entries.explanation: be acceptable to someone 表示某人可接受。

entries.prompt: All invoices _____ after the deadline will be processed next month.
entries.promptZh: 截止期限後收到的所有發票將於下月處理。
entries.explanation: invoices 與 receive 是被動關係，用過去分詞。

entries.prompt: Please notify the receptionist _____ you expect a visitor.
entries.promptZh: 若你預計有訪客，請通知接待人員。
entries.explanation: if + 子句表示條件。

entries.prompt: Only after the software was updated _____ the error disappear.
entries.promptZh: 直到軟體更新後，錯誤才消失。
entries.explanation: 先還原為 The error disappeared only after the software was updated。disappear 是一般動詞，Only after 置首後要補 did 並把 disappeared 還原成 disappear：did the error disappear。

entries.prompt: The hotel will _____ guests for any charges made in error.
entries.promptZh: 飯店將退還顧客任何誤收的費用。
entries.explanation: reimburse someone for charges 表示償還誤收費用。

entries.prompt: The expansion project requires careful financial _____.
entries.promptZh: 擴建計畫需要審慎的財務規劃。
entries.explanation: financial planning 是固定名詞搭配。

entries.prompt: The two proposals are similar, but the second is less expensive than _____.
entries.promptZh: 兩份提案相似，但第二份比另一份便宜。
entries.explanation: 兩者中的另一個用 the other。

entries.prompt: The warranty remains valid _____ three years from the date of purchase.
entries.promptZh: 保固自購買日起有效三年。
entries.explanation: for + 一段時間。

entries.prompt: The final decision rests _____ the executive committee.
entries.promptZh: 最終決定權在執行委員會。
entries.explanation: rest with someone 表示由某人負責決定。

entries.prompt: The new regulations are applicable _____ all overseas branches.
entries.promptZh: 新規定適用於所有海外分公司。
entries.explanation: be applicable to 是固定搭配。

entries.prompt: Several employees expressed concern _____ the proposed schedule change.
entries.promptZh: 數名員工對所提議的時程變更表示擔憂。
entries.explanation: express concern about 是固定搭配。

entries.prompt: The hotel offers _____ transportation to and from the airport.
entries.promptZh: 飯店提供免費機場接送。
entries.explanation: 修飾 transportation 使用形容詞 complimentary，意為免費的。

entries.prompt: The board requested a more _____ analysis of the proposal.
entries.promptZh: 董事會要求對提案進行更詳細的分析。
entries.explanation: 修飾 analysis 使用形容詞 detailed。

entries.prompt: The research team _____ the survey results before publishing its report.
entries.promptZh: 研究團隊將在發布報告前核實調查結果。
entries.explanation: 在未來發布報告前將先核實結果，使用未來式。

entries.prompt: This is the first time the company _____ a conference in Bangkok.
entries.promptZh: 這是公司第一次在曼谷舉辦會議。
entries.explanation: This is the first time + 現在完成式。

entries.prompt: The applicants, several of _____ have worked abroad, will be interviewed today.
entries.promptZh: 這些申請者中有幾位曾在海外工作，他們今天將接受面試。
entries.explanation: 介系詞 of 後指人，使用 whom。

entries.prompt: The committee will discuss _____ additional funding is necessary.
entries.promptZh: 委員會將討論是否需要額外資金。
entries.explanation: whether 引導「是否需要」的名詞子句。

entries.prompt: Customers _____ to the loyalty program receive monthly coupons.
entries.promptZh: 加入忠誠方案的顧客每月會收到優惠券。
entries.explanation: customers subscribed to... 表示已加入方案的顧客。

entries.prompt: _____ all required documents, the applicant proceeded to the interview room.
entries.promptZh: 提交所有必要文件後，申請者前往面試室。
entries.explanation: 先提交文件再前往面試室，用 Having submitted。

entries.prompt: Only a _____ employees volunteered for the weekend event.
entries.promptZh: 只有少數員工自願參加週末活動。
entries.explanation: employees 為可數複數，a few 表示一些。

entries.prompt: This year's exhibition attracted _____ visitors than last year's event.
entries.promptZh: 今年的展覽比去年吸引更多訪客。
entries.explanation: than 搭配比較級 more。

entries.prompt: The company will _____ the damaged items at no additional cost.
entries.promptZh: 公司將免費更換受損商品。
entries.explanation: replace damaged items 表示更換受損商品。

entries.prompt: Managers are expected to _____ potential risks before approving a project.
entries.promptZh: 經理在核准專案前應評估潛在風險。
entries.explanation: assess risks 表示評估風險。

entries.prompt: The conference registration fee must be paid _____ advance.
entries.promptZh: 會議報名費必須預先支付。
entries.explanation: in advance 是固定片語。

entries.prompt: The renovation was completed _____ accordance with local safety regulations.
entries.promptZh: 整修工程依照當地安全法規完成。
entries.explanation: in accordance with 表示依照。

entries.prompt: The committee is composed _____ representatives from six departments.
entries.promptZh: 委員會由六個部門的代表組成。
entries.explanation: be composed of 表示由……組成。

entries.prompt: Employees should be mindful _____ confidential information when working remotely.
entries.promptZh: 員工遠端工作時應留意機密資訊。
entries.explanation: be mindful of 是固定搭配。

entries.prompt: The company announced the _____ opening of its new distribution center.
entries.promptZh: 公司宣布新配送中心正式啟用。
entries.explanation: 修飾 opening 用形容詞 official。

entries.prompt: The survey results were presented in a clear and _____ manner.
entries.promptZh: 調查結果以清楚有條理的方式呈現。
entries.explanation: 修飾 manner 使用形容詞 organized。

entries.prompt: The manager will call you as soon as she _____ from the meeting.
entries.promptZh: 經理一結束會議回來就會打給你。
entries.explanation: 時間副詞子句表示未來時，用現在簡單式。

entries.prompt: By next January, Mr. Singh _____ at the company for ten years.
entries.promptZh: 到明年一月，Singh 先生將在公司任職滿十年。
entries.explanation: by + 未來時間點搭配未來完成式。

entries.prompt: The warehouse has a loading area _____ trucks can park safely.
entries.promptZh: 倉庫設有卡車可安全停放的裝卸區。
entries.explanation: 先行詞 loading area 為地點，用 where。

entries.prompt: The proposal, the details of _____ remain confidential, will be discussed tomorrow.
entries.promptZh: 該提案細節仍屬機密，將於明天討論。
entries.explanation: the details of which 是正式所有關係。

entries.prompt: Products _____ online can be returned to any branch location.
entries.promptZh: 網路購買的產品可退至任何分店。
entries.explanation: 產品是被購買，用過去分詞 purchased。

entries.prompt: _____ the updated figures, the analyst revised the forecast.
entries.promptZh: 檢視更新後的數據後，分析師修正預測。
entries.explanation: 先檢視數據，再修正預測。

entries.prompt: Please keep the receipt _____ you need to request a refund.
entries.promptZh: 請保留收據，以防需要申請退款。
entries.explanation: in case + 子句表示以防。

entries.prompt: The store extended its hours _____ accommodate holiday shoppers.
entries.promptZh: 商店延長營業時間以服務假期購物者。
entries.explanation: in order to + V 表示目的。

entries.prompt: Neither of the two conference rooms has _____ own projector.
entries.promptZh: 兩間會議室都沒有自己的投影機。
entries.explanation: Neither 視為單數，使用 its。

entries.prompt: Some employees prefer morning sessions, while _____ choose afternoon sessions.
entries.promptZh: 有些員工偏好上午課程，另一些選擇下午。
entries.explanation: some...others... 表示一些……另一些……。

entries.prompt: The updated application runs _____ than the previous version.
entries.promptZh: 更新後的應用程式比前一版運作更順暢。
entries.explanation: 修飾 runs 並作比較，用 more smoothly。

entries.prompt: Rarely _____ such a large number of applicants for one position.
entries.promptZh: 我們很少收到這麼多人申請同一職缺。
entries.explanation: 正常語序是 We rarely receive such a large number of applicants。receive 是一般動詞，Rarely 置首後使用 do-support：do we receive；不能寫 we receive，因為主句必須部分倒裝。

entries.prompt: The company hired an outside firm to _____ the security audit.
entries.promptZh: 公司聘請外部公司執行安全稽核。
entries.explanation: conduct an audit 表示執行稽核。

entries.prompt: The manufacturer agreed to _____ the cost of shipping the replacement unit.
entries.promptZh: 製造商同意承擔替換設備的運費。
entries.explanation: absorb the cost 表示承擔費用。

entries.prompt: Had the invoice been submitted earlier, the reimbursement _____ before the holiday.
entries.promptZh: 如果發票早一點提交，報銷款就會在假日前處理完成。
entries.explanation: Had the invoice been submitted earlier 等於 If the invoice had been submitted earlier。省略 if 後將 had 移到主詞前；主句描述與過去事實相反的結果，因此用 would have been processed。

entries.prompt: The committee reviewed several policies, many of _____ had not been updated in over a decade.
entries.promptZh: 委員會審查了數項政策，其中許多已超過十年未更新。
entries.explanation: many of which 指 several policies 中的許多項，是正式書面常見結構。

entries.prompt: So detailed _____ that new employees can complete the procedure without assistance.
entries.promptZh: 這份手冊非常詳細，新員工可在無協助下完成流程。
entries.explanation: 正常語序是 The manual is so detailed that ...。將 So + 形容詞置首強調時，be 動詞移到主詞前：So detailed is the manual that ...。

entries.prompt: _____ by the positive response, the marketing team expanded the campaign to three additional cities.
entries.promptZh: 受到正面回應鼓舞，行銷團隊將活動擴展到另外三個城市。
entries.explanation: 團隊是受到鼓舞，用過去分詞 Encouraged 表示被動原因。

entries.prompt: The board has not yet determined _____ the regional office will remain open after the merger.
entries.promptZh: 董事會尚未決定合併後區域辦公室是否仍會開放。
entries.explanation: determine 後可接 whether 名詞子句，表示是否仍會營運。

entries.prompt: The technician replaced the component, but the equipment continued to operate _____.
entries.promptZh: 技術員更換零件後，設備仍不穩定地運作。
entries.explanation: 修飾動詞 operate 需用副詞 erratically，表示不穩定地運作。

entries.prompt: _____ the initial estimate was low, the final cost remained within the approved budget.
entries.promptZh: 儘管初步估算偏低，最終成本仍在核准預算內。
entries.explanation: 前後語意為讓步對比，用 Even though 接完整子句。

entries.prompt: The revised policy is intended to be consistent _____ international accounting standards.
entries.promptZh: 修訂後的政策旨在與國際會計準則一致。
entries.explanation: be consistent with 表示與某標準一致。

entries.prompt: The announcement that the plant would reopen next month _____ many suppliers by surprise.
entries.promptZh: 工廠下月重新開放的公告讓許多供應商感到意外。
entries.explanation: 主詞是 The announcement，後方 that 子句是同位語補充說明；主要動詞用過去式 took。

entries.prompt: The more frequently customers use the mobile app, _____ the company can personalize its offers.
entries.promptZh: 顧客越常使用行動應用程式，公司就越能個人化優惠。
entries.explanation: the more ..., the better ... 是成比例比較結構。

entries.prompt: _____ the revised safety guidelines, all laboratory staff must complete a short online assessment.
entries.promptZh: 看過修訂後的安全規範後，所有實驗室員工都必須完成一份簡短的線上測驗。
entries.explanation: 句意為「在已經看過修訂安全規範後」，用 Having reviewed 表示先完成的主動動作。

entries.prompt: The finance team is confident _____ the new reporting software will reduce manual errors.
entries.promptZh: 財務團隊確信新的報表軟體會減少人工錯誤。
entries.explanation: be confident that + 子句，表示確信某事會發生。

entries.prompt: The venue is smaller than expected; _____, the layout can still accommodate all registered participants.
entries.promptZh: 場地比預期小；然而，配置仍可容納所有已報名參與者。
entries.explanation: 前後語意為讓步轉折，nevertheless 表示「然而，即便如此」。

entries.prompt: All warranty claims must _____ by a copy of the original receipt.
entries.promptZh: 所有保固申請都必須附上原始收據影本。
entries.explanation: claims 是被附上收據，用 must be accompanied by。

entries.prompt: Rarely _____ such a detailed response from a vendor during the initial bidding stage.
entries.promptZh: 在初步投標階段，我們很少會從供應商收到如此詳細的回覆。
entries.explanation: 正常語序是 We rarely receive such a detailed response。receive 是一般動詞，Rarely 置首後要補 do 並放在主詞 we 前：do we receive。

entries.prompt: The consultant recommended _____ the customer survey before revising the service manual.
entries.promptZh: 顧問建議在修訂服務手冊前先檢視顧客調查。
entries.explanation: recommend 後面接動名詞作受詞，因此選 reviewing。

entries.prompt: What the auditors requested _____ a complete record of all travel reimbursements.
entries.promptZh: 稽核人員要求的是所有差旅報銷的完整紀錄。
entries.explanation: What 引導的名詞子句作主詞，指一項要求，動詞用單數 was。

entries.prompt: The software update will be installed overnight to minimize _____ to regular business operations.
entries.promptZh: 軟體更新將在夜間安裝，以盡量減少對正常業務運作的干擾。
entries.explanation: minimize 後面需要名詞作受詞，disruption 表示干擾或中斷。

entries.prompt: The construction work was completed _____ the restrictions imposed by the historic preservation board.
entries.promptZh: 儘管歷史保存委員會設下限制，工程仍已完成。
entries.explanation: restrictions 是名詞片語，表示『儘管有這些限制』時使用 in spite of。

entries.prompt: The downtown branch is located in a district _____ several technology firms have recently opened offices.
entries.promptZh: 市中心分行位於一個最近有數家科技公司開設辦公室的區域。
entries.explanation: district 表示地點，後面子句缺少地點副詞，因此使用 where。

entries.prompt: The redesigned invoice form is far _____ to process than the previous version.
entries.promptZh: 重新設計的發票表格比前一版更容易處理得多。
entries.explanation: far 可修飾比較級，且句中有 than，因此選 easier。

entries.prompt: By the time the quarterly figures are released, analysts _____ several possible outcomes.
entries.promptZh: 等季度數據公布時，分析師將已考量過幾種可能結果。
entries.explanation: By the time 加現在式表示未來時間點，主句強調到那時已完成的動作，用未來完成式。

entries.prompt: The procurement team has asked that all suppliers _____ updated safety certificates before April 30.
entries.promptZh: 採購團隊要求所有供應商在 4 月 30 日前提交更新後的安全證明。
entries.explanation: ask that 後方表示要求時，子句動詞用原形，因此選 submit。

entries.prompt: The warehouse manager will postpone the inventory inspection _____ the replacement scanner arrives.
entries.promptZh: 倉庫經理會延後庫存檢查，直到替換掃描器抵達。
entries.explanation: 句意為『直到替換掃描器抵達才進行檢查』，用 until 連接時間子句。

entries.prompt: Ms. Chen was praised for handling the client's request so _____.
entries.promptZh: 陳女士因如此有效率地處理客戶要求而受到稱讚。
entries.explanation: 修飾 handling 這個動作需要副詞 efficiently。

entries.prompt: The lease agreement must be reviewed by legal counsel before it is _____ by either party.
entries.promptZh: 租約在任一方簽署前，必須先由法律顧問審閱。
entries.explanation: 合約是被簽署，before it is signed 使用被動語態。

entries.prompt: Because attendance at the seminar is limited, employees are encouraged to register _____.
entries.promptZh: 由於研討會名額有限，鼓勵員工盡快登記。
entries.explanation: 修飾 register 這個動詞需要副詞 promptly，表示盡快登記。

entries.prompt: The revised brochure contains _____ information about the new warranty plan.
entries.promptZh: 修訂後的小冊子包含新保固方案的完整資訊。
entries.explanation: information 是名詞，前面需要形容詞 comprehensive 修飾。

entries.prompt: The technician confirmed that the printer had been installed _____.
entries.promptZh: 技術人員確認印表機已正確安裝。
entries.explanation: 修飾 had been installed 需要副詞 correctly。

entries.prompt: The quarterly report will be distributed to shareholders _____ it is approved by the board.
entries.promptZh: 季度報告一經董事會核准，就會分發給股東。
entries.explanation: once 表示『一旦』，符合報告經董事會核准後即分發的語意。

entries.prompt: The restaurant is looking for a supplier that can provide produce at a _____ price.
entries.promptZh: 這家餐廳正在尋找能以有競爭力價格供應農產品的供應商。
entries.explanation: price 是名詞，前方需要形容詞 competitive，表示有競爭力的價格。

entries.prompt: Please contact the facilities department if you notice any _____ in the conference room equipment.
entries.promptZh: 如果你注意到會議室設備有任何故障，請聯絡設施部門。
entries.explanation: any 後可接複數可數名詞，且句意為『任何故障』，選 malfunctions。

entries.prompt: The accounting department requested a more _____ explanation of the travel expenses.
entries.promptZh: 會計部門要求對差旅費用提出更詳細的說明。
entries.explanation: explanation 是名詞，前方需要形容詞 detailed 修飾。

entries.prompt: _____ the revised contract, the client asked several questions about the warranty terms.
entries.promptZh: 在審閱修訂後的合約之後，客戶問了幾個關於保固條款的問題。
entries.explanation: 句意為『在審閱修訂後的合約之後』，用 After reviewing。

entries.prompt: Participants must register online _____ noon on Friday to receive the early discount.
entries.promptZh: 參加者必須在週五中午前線上登記，才能獲得早鳥折扣。
entries.explanation: by noon 表示不晚於中午，符合期限語意。

entries.prompt: The first shipment arrived late; _____, the installation schedule had to be adjusted.
entries.promptZh: 第一批貨延遲抵達；因此，安裝時程必須調整。
entries.explanation: 前後為因果關係，分號後用 therefore 表示因此。

entries.prompt: The service representative will _____ customers of any changes to their delivery windows.
entries.promptZh: 客服代表將通知顧客任何配送時段的變更。
entries.explanation: will 後接原形動詞，notify customers of changes 表示通知顧客變更。

entries.prompt: The marketing team needs a more _____ estimate before approving the advertising budget.
entries.promptZh: 行銷團隊在核准廣告預算前，需要更精準的估算。
entries.explanation: estimate 是名詞，前方需要形容詞 accurate 修飾，表示更精準的估算。

entries.prompt: All reimbursement forms must be submitted _____ through the online portal.
entries.promptZh: 所有報銷表格都必須透過線上入口以電子方式提交。
entries.explanation: 空格修飾 submitted，需用副詞 electronically。

entries.prompt: By the time the auditors arrive next Monday, the finance team _____ the quarterly report.
entries.promptZh: 等稽核人員下週一抵達時，財務團隊將已完成季度報告。
entries.explanation: By the time 加未來時間點，主句表示屆時已完成，需用未來完成式 will have finalized。

entries.prompt: The revised safety guidelines apply _____ all employees working in the warehouse.
entries.promptZh: 修訂後的安全指南適用於所有在倉庫工作的員工。
entries.explanation: apply to 表示適用於，後接適用對象。

entries.prompt: _____ the replacement parts arrive today, the repair cannot be completed before Friday.
entries.promptZh: 除非替換零件今天抵達，否則維修無法在週五前完成。
entries.explanation: 空格後是完整子句 the replacement parts arrive today，需用連接詞 Unless。

entries.prompt: The consultant _____ recommendations were adopted by the board will lead the next review.
entries.promptZh: 其建議被董事會採納的那位顧問將主持下一次審查。
entries.explanation: recommendations 屬於 consultant，需用所有格關係代名詞 whose。

entries.prompt: The operations manager asked staff members to _____ any delays directly to the logistics desk.
entries.promptZh: 營運經理要求員工將任何延誤直接回報給物流櫃台。
entries.explanation: ask + 人 + to + 原形動詞，需用 report。

entries.prompt: The cybersecurity team requested a more _____ review of the vendor's data-handling procedures.
entries.promptZh: 資安團隊要求更徹底審查該供應商的資料處理程序。
entries.explanation: review 是名詞，前方需要形容詞 thorough 修飾，表示更徹底的審查。

entries.prompt: By the end of the pilot program, the engineering team _____ the battery-monitoring sensors on all delivery vehicles.
entries.promptZh: 到試點計畫結束時，工程團隊將已在所有配送車上安裝電池監測感測器。
entries.explanation: By the end of the pilot program 表示未來某時間點前完成，需用未來完成式 will have installed。

entries.prompt: The cloud architect will _____ the migration plan with department managers before the launch.
entries.promptZh: 雲端架構師會在上線前與各部門經理審查遷移計畫。
entries.explanation: will 後接原形動詞，review the migration plan 表示審查遷移計畫。

entries.prompt: The new privacy dashboard gives customers greater control _____ how their information is shared.
entries.promptZh: 新的隱私儀表板讓顧客更能控制其資訊如何被分享。
entries.explanation: control over 表示對某事有控制權，後接 how 子句說明控制內容。

entries.prompt: The system automatically backs up sensor data _____ to prevent interruptions in production.
entries.promptZh: 系統每小時自動備份感測器資料，以防生產中斷。
entries.explanation: 空格修飾 backs up，需用副詞 hourly，表示每小時自動備份。

entries.prompt: _____ concerns about server capacity, the analytics platform was rolled out to all regional offices.
entries.promptZh: 儘管有人擔心伺服器容量，該分析平台仍推廣到所有區域辦公室。
entries.explanation: concerns 是名詞片語，需用介系詞 Despite；Although / Because / Unless 後接完整子句。

entries.prompt: The technician _____ configured the robotic arm will train operators next week.
entries.promptZh: 設定機械手臂的那位技術人員下週將訓練操作員。
entries.explanation: 先行詞 technician 是人，且從句缺主詞，因此用 who。

entries.prompt: The product team will conduct a small-scale _____ before releasing the wearable device worldwide.
entries.promptZh: 產品團隊會在全球發布穿戴式裝置前進行小規模試驗。
entries.explanation: small-scale trial 表示小規模試驗；trail 是小徑或蹤跡，不合語意。

entries.prompt: The board has not yet decided _____ the company will build its own data center or lease space from a provider.
entries.promptZh: 董事會尚未決定公司是否要自建資料中心，或向供應商租用空間。
entries.explanation: decided 後接名詞子句，whether A or B 表示是否要在兩方案間選擇。

entries.prompt: The prototype reduced power consumption by 12 percent; _____, management approved a larger production test.
entries.promptZh: 原型機降低了 12% 的耗電量；因此，管理層批准了更大規模的生產測試。
entries.explanation: 前句說原型降低耗電，後句說管理層批准更大測試，兩者為因果關係，用 therefore。

entries.prompt: Not until the quarterly audit _____ the discrepancy visible to management.
entries.promptZh: 直到季度稽核時，管理階層才看出這項差異。
entries.explanation: 正常語序是 The discrepancy was not visible to management until the quarterly audit。visible 是形容詞，主要動詞是 was；Not until 置首後直接倒裝為 was the discrepancy visible。空格後已有主詞，不能再加入 it。

entries.prompt: Not until the finance team compared both invoices _____ they discover the duplicate charge.
entries.promptZh: 直到財務團隊比對兩張發票後，他們才發現重複收費。
entries.explanation: 正常語序是 They did not discover the duplicate charge until ...。discover 是一般動詞，Not until 置首後補過去式助動詞 did，並使用原形 discover。

entries.prompt: Only after the vendor sent the replacement parts _____ the machine resume production.
entries.promptZh: 直到供應商寄出替換零件後，機器才恢復生產。
entries.explanation: 正常語序是 The machine resumed production only after ...。resume 是一般動詞；Only after 置首後使用 did + 主詞 + 原形動詞：did the machine resume。

entries.prompt: Only when the backup server came online _____ the team able to restore the archived files.
entries.promptZh: 只有在備援伺服器上線後，團隊才能還原封存檔案。
entries.explanation: 正常語序是 The team was able to restore ... only when ...。be able to 的主要動詞是 was；Only when 置首後直接倒裝為 was the team able。

entries.prompt: Never before _____ the committee received so many proposals in a single week.
entries.promptZh: 該委員會從未在一週內收到這麼多提案。
entries.explanation: received 在此是過去分詞；搭配 Never before 表示截至現在的經驗，使用現在完成式。Never 置首後將 has 移到主詞前：has the committee received。

entries.prompt: Seldom _____ employees need to contact support after completing the guided installation.
entries.promptZh: 員工完成引導式安裝後，很少需要聯絡技術支援。
entries.explanation: 正常語序是 Employees seldom need to contact support。need 是一般動詞且描述一般情況；Seldom 置首後補 do：do employees need。

entries.prompt: Rarely _____ the loading area this quiet during regular business hours.
entries.promptZh: 正常營業時間內，裝卸區很少如此安靜。
entries.explanation: this quiet 是形容詞補語，句子的主要動詞是 is。Rarely 置首後直接將 be 動詞放在主詞前：is the loading area this quiet。

entries.prompt: Under no circumstances _____ visitors enter the clean room without an authorized badge.
entries.promptZh: 訪客在任何情況下都不得未持授權識別證進入無塵室。
entries.explanation: Under no circumstances 是否定限制片語，置首後主句部分倒裝。原句已有情態動詞 may，直接移到主詞 visitors 前：may visitors enter。

entries.prompt: Little _____ the project manager know that the vendor had already shipped the revised samples.
entries.promptZh: 專案經理完全不知道供應商早已寄出修訂樣品。
entries.explanation: Little 在此表示「完全沒料到」，具有否定語意。know 是一般動詞，Little 置首後補過去式助動詞 did：Little did the project manager know。

entries.prompt: No sooner _____ the contract been signed than the legal department requested an amendment.
entries.promptZh: 合約才剛簽署，法務部門就要求修訂。
entries.explanation: 固定句型是 No sooner had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + than ...，表示前一動作剛完成，下一動作立刻發生。been signed 已是完成式被動，因此選 had。

entries.prompt: Hardly _____ the webinar begun when the connection failed.
entries.promptZh: 網路研討會才剛開始，連線就中斷了。
entries.explanation: 固定句型是 Hardly had + 主詞 + 過去分詞 + when ...。begun 是 begin 的過去分詞，因此使用 had the webinar begun。

entries.prompt: Not only _____ the update improve security, but it also reduced loading times.
entries.promptZh: 這次更新不僅提升安全性，也縮短了載入時間。
entries.explanation: Not only 置於句首且修飾主要子句時要部分倒裝。improve 是原形，後文 reduced 顯示過去時間，因此使用 did the update improve。

entries.prompt: At no time _____ customer records accessible from the public network.
entries.promptZh: 客戶資料從未能透過公共網路存取。
entries.explanation: accessible 是形容詞補語，主要動詞是 were。At no time 置首後將 be 動詞移到主詞 customer records 前：were customer records accessible。

entries.prompt: Only then _____ the finance team understand why the totals did not match.
entries.promptZh: 直到那時，財務團隊才明白總額為何不一致。
entries.explanation: understand 是一般動詞，Only then 置首後要部分倒裝。句意描述過去事件，因此補 did，並保留原形 understand。

entries.prompt: On no account _____ confidential files be sent through a personal e-mail account.
entries.promptZh: 機密檔案絕不可透過私人電子郵件帳號寄送。
entries.explanation: On no account 表示「絕不」，置首後要倒裝。句中已有被動原形 be sent，前面需接情態動詞 should：should confidential files be sent。

entries.prompt: Nowhere else _____ customers obtain the same repair service on weekends.
entries.promptZh: 顧客在其他任何地方都無法於週末取得同樣的維修服務。
entries.explanation: Nowhere else 具有否定限制語意，置首後要部分倒裝。原句的情態動詞 can 移到主詞 customers 前：can customers obtain。

entries.prompt: So effective _____ the revised schedule that all delayed inspections were completed by Friday.
entries.promptZh: 修訂後的時程非常有效，使所有延誤的檢查都在週五前完成。
entries.explanation: 正常語序是 The revised schedule was so effective that ...。So + 形容詞置首強調時，將 be 動詞移到主詞前：So effective was the revised schedule。

entries.prompt: Such _____ the demand for the workshop that a second session was added.
entries.promptZh: 工作坊需求如此熱烈，因此加開了第二場。
entries.explanation: 正常語序是 The demand for the workshop was such that ...。Such 置首強調時，be 動詞移到主詞前：Such was the demand。

entries.prompt: Neither _____ the supplier issue a refund, nor did it offer a replacement.
entries.promptZh: 供應商既未退款，也未提供替換品。
entries.explanation: Neither 置首表示兩項否定時，第一個子句要倒裝。issue 是原形且後半句使用 did，故為 Neither did the supplier issue ... nor did it offer ...。

entries.prompt: The first quotation did not include installation, and neither _____ the revised quotation.
entries.promptZh: 第一份報價未包含安裝費，修訂後的報價也沒有。
entries.explanation: neither 表示後者也同樣不包含。前句使用 did not include，後句省略重複動詞 include，保留倒裝結構 neither did the revised quotation。

entries.prompt: The original estimate has not been approved, nor _____ the revised budget.
entries.promptZh: 原始估價尚未核准，修訂後的預算也尚未核准。
entries.explanation: 前句使用現在完成式 has not been approved。nor 連接相同否定情況時要倒裝，並沿用助動詞 has：nor has the revised budget。

entries.prompt: _____ you require a printed receipt, select that option before submitting the form.
entries.promptZh: 如果您需要紙本收據，請在送出表單前選取該選項。
entries.explanation: Should you require ... 等於 If you should require ...。條件句省略 if 後，將 should 移到主詞 you 前；這是正式商務用語。

entries.prompt: _____ the supplier to miss the second deadline, the contract would automatically be reviewed.
entries.promptZh: 若供應商再次錯過期限，合約將自動進入審查。
entries.explanation: Were the supplier to miss ... 等於 If the supplier were to miss ...，表示較不可能的未來假設。Were + 主詞 + to V 是正式條件倒裝。

entries.prompt: _____ the maintenance team known about the voltage issue, it would have tested the circuit first.
entries.promptZh: 如果維修團隊早知道電壓問題，就會先測試電路。
entries.explanation: Had the maintenance team known ... 等於 If the maintenance team had known ...。這是與過去事實相反的條件句，省略 if 後將 had 移到主詞前。

entries.prompt: The procurement team compared several AI transcription services before choosing the provider with the most _____ privacy policy.
entries.promptZh: 採購團隊比較了幾項 AI 轉錄服務，最後選擇隱私政策最透明的供應商。
entries.explanation: policy 是名詞，前面需要形容詞修飾；transparent privacy policy 表示透明的隱私政策。

entries.prompt: The new scheduling app will notify technicians _____ a replacement part becomes available.
entries.promptZh: 新的排程應用程式會在替換零件可取得時立刻通知技術人員。
entries.explanation: 句意是「零件一可取得就通知」，需要表示時間的連接詞 as soon as。

entries.prompt: The data analyst recommended that the dashboard _____ updated every Friday.
entries.promptZh: 資料分析師建議儀表板每週五更新。
entries.explanation: recommend that 後面常接原形動詞；被動語意用 be updated。

entries.prompt: Several engineers remained in the lab after hours _____ the quantum-safe encryption test.
entries.promptZh: 幾位工程師下班後仍留在實驗室，以完成量子安全加密測試。
entries.explanation: 空格表示留下來的目的，應使用不定詞 to complete。

entries.prompt: The report, _____ includes feedback from remote users, will be presented on Monday.
entries.promptZh: 這份包含遠端使用者回饋的報告將在週一提出。
entries.explanation: 先行詞是 report，非限定關係子句中用 which 補充說明。

entries.prompt: Because the prototype was assembled _____, the quality team requested another inspection.
entries.promptZh: 因為原型組裝得很倉促，品質團隊要求再次檢查。
entries.explanation: 空格修飾 was assembled 這個動作，需要副詞 hastily。

entries.prompt: The company has invested heavily in sensors that can detect equipment problems before they _____ production.
entries.promptZh: 公司大幅投資能在設備問題干擾生產前偵測出異常的感測器。
entries.explanation: they 是主詞，空格需要動詞；disrupt production 表示干擾生產。

entries.prompt: The training portal is accessible _____ employees who have completed the security briefing.
entries.promptZh: 完成資安簡報的員工可以使用訓練入口網站。
entries.explanation: accessible to someone 是固定搭配，表示某人可以使用。

entries.prompt: The logistics director asked whether the autonomous carts could operate _____ in low-light areas.
entries.promptZh: 物流主管詢問自動搬運車是否能在低光源區域安全運作。
entries.explanation: operate 是動詞，需用副詞 safely 修飾。

entries.prompt: Following the software update, customer-service wait times decreased _____.
entries.promptZh: 軟體更新後，客服等待時間大幅下降。
entries.explanation: decreased 是動詞，空格需用副詞 significantly 表示大幅下降。

entries.prompt: The sustainability team needs a more _____ method for measuring energy use across all branches.
entries.promptZh: 永續團隊需要更可靠的方法來測量各分店的能源使用量。
entries.explanation: method 是名詞，前面需要形容詞 reliable 修飾。

entries.prompt: By the time the audit begins, the finance department _____ the new expense-tracking system.
entries.promptZh: 等稽核開始時，財務部門將已導入新的費用追蹤系統。
entries.explanation: By the time + 未來時間，主句用未來完成式 will have implemented。

entries.prompt: Employees are responsible _____ reporting any suspicious requests for customer data.
entries.promptZh: 員工有責任回報任何可疑的客戶資料請求。
entries.explanation: be responsible for V-ing 是固定搭配，表示負責做某事。

entries.prompt: The software license will renew automatically _____ the purchasing team cancels it by June 30.
entries.promptZh: 除非採購團隊在 6 月 30 日前取消，否則軟體授權會自動續約。
entries.explanation: 句意是除非採購團隊在 6 月 30 日前取消，否則授權會自動續約；用 unless。

entries.prompt: The new routing algorithm _____ reduced fuel consumption on long-distance deliveries.
entries.promptZh: 新的路線演算法大幅降低了長途配送的燃料消耗。
entries.explanation: reduced 是動詞，前面用副詞 substantially 修飾。

entries.prompt: _____ the beta feedback, the product team postponed the public release.
entries.promptZh: 在檢視 beta 回饋後，產品團隊延後公開發布。
entries.explanation: 句意是產品團隊在檢視 beta 回饋後延後發布，用 After reviewing。

entries.prompt: The consultant provided a detailed _____ of the risks associated with biometric login.
entries.promptZh: 顧問提供了與生物辨識登入相關風險的詳細評估。
entries.explanation: a detailed 後面需要單數名詞，assessment 表示評估。

entries.prompt: The technician _____ repaired the charging station will return tomorrow for a final inspection.
entries.promptZh: 修理充電站的技術人員明天會回來做最後檢查。
entries.explanation: 先行詞 technician 是人，關係代名詞用 who。

entries.prompt: The policy requires that all generated reports _____ reviewed by a supervisor.
entries.promptZh: 政策要求所有生成的報告都必須由主管審閱。
entries.explanation: require that 後面常用原形動詞；被動語意為 be reviewed。

entries.prompt: The trial version lacks offline access; _____, several field employees prefer the older app.
entries.promptZh: 試用版缺少離線存取功能；因此，幾位外勤員工偏好舊版應用程式。
entries.explanation: 前因後果關係：試用版缺少離線存取，因此員工偏好舊版，使用 therefore。

entries.prompt: The committee has not decided _____ the chatbot should be available outside business hours.
entries.promptZh: 委員會尚未決定聊天機器人是否應在營業時間外開放。
entries.explanation: decided 後面接名詞子句，whether 表示是否。

entries.prompt: The facilities team will _____ the air-quality sensors after the renovation is complete.
entries.promptZh: 翻修完成後，設施團隊會校準空氣品質感測器。
entries.explanation: will 後面接原形動詞，calibrate 表示校準。

entries.prompt: The legal team requested a more _____ explanation of how the voice assistant stores user commands.
entries.promptZh: 法務團隊要求更具體說明語音助理如何儲存使用者指令。
entries.explanation: explanation 是名詞，前面需要形容詞 specific 修飾。

entries.prompt: The maintenance contract provides coverage _____ software defects discovered during the first year.
entries.promptZh: 維護合約提供第一年內發現之軟體瑕疵的保障。
entries.explanation: coverage for something 是固定搭配，表示針對某項問題提供保障。

entries.prompt: The warehouse dashboard updates inventory levels _____ whenever a scanner uploads new data.
entries.promptZh: 每當掃描器上傳新資料時，倉庫儀表板會自動更新庫存量。
entries.explanation: updates 是動詞，需用副詞 automatically 修飾。

entries.prompt: The company will not activate facial recognition _____ all employees have completed the privacy notice.
entries.promptZh: 公司要等所有員工完成隱私通知後才會啟用臉部辨識。
entries.explanation: not...until 表示直到某條件達成才會啟用。

entries.prompt: The engineer made several _____ to the battery design after reviewing field-test data.
entries.promptZh: 工程師在檢視實地測試資料後，對電池設計做了幾項調整。
entries.explanation: several 後面接複數名詞，adjustments 表示調整。

entries.prompt: The help desk _____ more than 300 password-reset requests since the new portal went live.
entries.promptZh: 自新入口網站上線以來，服務台已處理超過 300 件密碼重設請求。
entries.explanation: since the new portal went live 表示從過去到現在，主句用現在完成式 has processed。

entries.prompt: The analytics tool can _____ unusual spending patterns within a few seconds.
entries.promptZh: 分析工具能在幾秒內辨識異常支出模式。
entries.explanation: can 後面接原形動詞，identify 表示辨識。

entries.prompt: The office _____ the remote-support team uses on Tuesdays has been upgraded with new cameras.
entries.promptZh: 遠端支援團隊週二使用的辦公室已升級新攝影機。
entries.explanation: 先行詞 office 是地點/物，且關係子句中 uses 缺受詞，可用 that。

entries.prompt: Please save a local copy of the presentation _____ the conference Wi-Fi becomes unstable.
entries.promptZh: 請儲存一份簡報的本機副本，以防會議 Wi-Fi 變得不穩定。
entries.explanation: in case 表示以防萬一，符合 Wi-Fi 不穩時需要本機備份的語意。

entries.prompt: The data _____ from wearable devices will be reviewed only by authorized researchers.
entries.promptZh: 從穿戴式裝置收集的資料只會由授權研究人員審閱。
entries.explanation: data 和 collect 是被動關係，用過去分詞 collected 修飾名詞。

entries.prompt: The help-desk chatbot now answers routine password questions more _____.
entries.promptZh: 客服聊天機器人現在能更準確地回答例行密碼問題。
entries.explanation: answers 是動詞，more 後面需要副詞修飾動作，因此選 accurately。

entries.prompt: The dashboard will display archived tickets _____ users select the history filter.
entries.promptZh: 當使用者選擇歷史篩選器時，儀表板會顯示封存票券。
entries.explanation: 句意是使用者選擇 history filter 時，dashboard 會顯示封存票券；表示時間條件，用 when。

entries.prompt: The laboratory purchased additional _____ for testing rechargeable batteries.
entries.promptZh: 實驗室購買了額外設備，用於測試充電電池。
entries.explanation: additional 後面需要名詞作 purchased 的受詞；equipment 是不可數名詞，符合句意。

entries.prompt: The compliance manager scheduled a short meeting _____ the new data-retention rules.
entries.promptZh: 法遵經理安排了一場短會，以說明新的資料保存規則。
entries.explanation: scheduled a meeting 後用 to explain 表目的，表示安排會議是為了說明新的資料保存規則。

entries.prompt: The analytics dashboard updates _____ after the sales data is uploaded.
entries.promptZh: 銷售資料上傳後，分析儀表板會自動更新。
entries.explanation: 空格修飾動詞 updates，表示「自動地更新」，因此要用副詞 automatically。

entries.prompt: Please archive the completed support tickets _____ closing the monthly report.
entries.promptZh: 請在結束月報之前，封存已完成的支援工單。
entries.explanation: 句意是「在結束月報之前，請先封存已完成的支援工單」，before 後接動名詞 closing 合乎語意與文法。

entries.prompt: The compliance team requires all vendors _____ the revised data-retention policy.
entries.promptZh: 法遵團隊要求所有供應商簽署修訂後的資料保留政策。
entries.explanation: require + object + to V 是常見結構，表示「要求某人做某事」，因此選 to sign。

entries.prompt: The mobile app displays a confirmation message _____ a customer resets the password.
entries.promptZh: 顧客重設密碼後，手機應用程式會顯示確認訊息。
entries.explanation: 句意需要時間順序：「顧客重設密碼後，App 會顯示確認訊息」，因此選 after。

entries.prompt: The presenter asked for a backup projector because the image in Room C was _____.
entries.promptZh: 簡報者要求備用投影機，因為 C 會議室的畫面太暗。
entries.explanation: be 動詞後需要描述狀態的形容詞片語；too dark 表示「太暗」，符合投影畫面的情境。

entries.prompt: Conference attendees may check in at the kiosk by scanning the QR code on their _____.
entries.promptZh: 會議與會者可以在自助報到機掃描票券上的 QR code 來報到。
entries.explanation: their 後面需要名詞；attendees 是複數，通常對應 their tickets，表示「他們的票券」。

entries.prompt: The IT analyst found that the sensor readings were not _____ recorded overnight.
entries.promptZh: IT 分析師發現感測器讀數在夜間沒有被準確記錄。
entries.explanation: 空格修飾 recorded，應使用副詞 accurately，表示「準確地記錄」。

entries.prompt: The legal department will review the vendor agreement _____ it is uploaded to the client portal.
entries.promptZh: 法務部門會在供應商合約上傳到客戶入口網站前進行審閱。
entries.explanation: 句意是「上傳前先審閱」，before 可引導完整子句 it is uploaded。

entries.prompt: Employees can use the template to create expense reports more _____.
entries.promptZh: 員工可以使用範本更有效率地建立費用報告。
entries.explanation: 空格修飾 create 這個動作，more 後接副詞 efficiently，表示「更有效率地」。

entries.prompt: The customer service team added captions to make the webinar _____ to overseas participants.
entries.promptZh: 客服團隊加入字幕，使網路研討會對海外參與者更容易理解與使用。
entries.explanation: make + object + adjective 表示「使某物變得如何」，因此要用形容詞 accessible。

entries.prompt: The monthly report was reviewed _____ before it was sent to investors.
entries.promptZh: 月報在寄給投資人之前被仔細審閱。
entries.explanation: 空格修飾動詞 reviewed，應使用副詞 carefully。

entries.prompt: The maintenance team postponed the elevator inspection _____ replacement parts had not arrived.
entries.promptZh: 維修團隊因替換零件尚未到貨而延後電梯檢查。
entries.explanation: 後半句說零件尚未抵達，是延期檢查的原因，因此選 because。

entries.prompt: All visitors must present photo _____ before entering the research laboratory.
entries.promptZh: 所有訪客進入研究實驗室前都必須出示照片證件。
entries.explanation: photo identification 是固定搭配，表示照片證件。

entries.prompt: The consultant recommended _____ the client portal before the system upgrade.
entries.promptZh: 顧問建議在系統升級前測試客戶入口網站。
entries.explanation: recommend 後面接動名詞 testing，表示建議進行測試。

entries.prompt: The new security policy applies _____ all employees, contractors, and visitors.
entries.promptZh: 新的安全政策適用於所有員工、承包商與訪客。
entries.explanation: apply to 表示「適用於」，符合政策適用對象。

entries.prompt: By the time the regional director arrives, the finance team _____ the forecast.
entries.promptZh: 到區域主管抵達時，財務團隊將已修訂預測。
entries.explanation: By the time + 現在式 表示未來某時間點前完成，主句用未來完成式 will have revised。

entries.prompt: The updated brochure provides _____ information about the warranty.
entries.promptZh: 更新後的小冊子提供保固的詳細資訊。
entries.explanation: 空格修飾名詞 information，需要形容詞 detailed。

entries.prompt: _____ the shipping delay, the supplier still expects to meet the project deadline.
entries.promptZh: 儘管出貨延遲，供應商仍預期能趕上專案截止日。
entries.explanation: despite + 名詞 表示「儘管」，後面接 the shipping delay 合乎句型。

entries.prompt: The training materials are stored online, and employees may download _____ at any time.
entries.promptZh: 訓練教材存放在線上，員工可隨時下載它們。
entries.explanation: download 後面需要受格代名詞 them，代替 training materials。

entries.prompt: The new inventory scanner processes bar codes much _____ than the previous model.
entries.promptZh: 新的庫存掃描器處理條碼的速度比前一款快很多。
entries.explanation: than the previous model 表示比較，much 可修飾比較級 faster。

entries.prompt: The engineer _____ designed the sensor system will lead tomorrow's demonstration.
entries.promptZh: 設計感測器系統的工程師將主持明天的示範。
entries.explanation: 空格在關係子句中作主詞，先行詞 engineer 是人，因此用 who。

entries.prompt: The customer satisfaction survey is conducted _____ to track service trends.
entries.promptZh: 顧客滿意度調查每季進行一次，以追蹤服務趨勢。
entries.explanation: quarterly 可作副詞，表示每季一次，修飾 is conducted。

entries.prompt: Several _____ from the marketing department attended the product launch.
entries.promptZh: 行銷部門的幾位代表參加了產品發表會。
entries.explanation: Several 後面接可數複數名詞 representatives。

entries.prompt: The _____ instructions helped new users set up the software without assistance.
entries.promptZh: 圖解說明幫助新使用者不需協助即可設定軟體。
entries.explanation: instructions 需要形容詞修飾，illustrated instructions 表示有圖解的說明。

entries.prompt: Employees are encouraged _____ questions during the compliance workshop.
entries.promptZh: 員工被鼓勵在法遵工作坊期間提問。
entries.explanation: be encouraged to V 表示被鼓勵做某事，因此選 to ask。

entries.prompt: The delivery driver called to say that the shipment was _____ schedule.
entries.promptZh: 送貨司機打電話來說貨物比預定時間早到。
entries.explanation: ahead of schedule 是固定片語，表示比預定時程早。

entries.prompt: The manager explained _____ the new reimbursement policy would take effect.
entries.promptZh: 經理解釋新的報銷政策何時生效。
entries.explanation: explained 後接名詞子句，when 引導「何時生效」的內容。

entries.prompt: The hotel will _____ free shuttle service during the technology conference.
entries.promptZh: 飯店將在科技會議期間提供免費接駁服務。
entries.explanation: provide service 表示提供服務，符合句意。

entries.prompt: Please submit _____ expense receipts to the accounting office by Friday.
entries.promptZh: 請在星期五前將你的費用收據提交給會計辦公室。
entries.explanation: 空格後有名詞 expense receipts，因此需要所有格形容詞 your。

entries.prompt: _____ you need technical assistance, contact the help desk before 6 P.M.
entries.promptZh: 若你需要技術協助，請在下午六點前聯絡服務台。
entries.explanation: Should you need... 是正式用法，等於 If you should need...。

entries.prompt: The pilot program was designed to collect customer feedback _____ before the company invested in a full launch.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: 空格修飾 collect feedback，應用副詞 gradually，表示逐步收集後再決定是否全面推出。

entries.prompt: _____ the updated instructions were longer, users completed the setup process with fewer errors.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: 前後句意是「說明更長」但「錯誤更少」，需要讓步連接詞 Although。

entries.prompt: The committee requested a clearer _____ of how visitor data would be stored.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: a clearer 後面需要名詞 explanation，表示更清楚的說明。

entries.prompt: _____ on feedback from test users, the design team replaced the swipe gesture with a button.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: Based on... 是固定分詞片語，表示根據使用者回饋。

entries.prompt: The repair request will not be processed _____ the customer provides the product serial number.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: unless 表示「除非」，符合沒有序號就不處理的條件。

entries.prompt: The report separates indoor and outdoor test results to make the findings more _____.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: make + object + adjective，用 meaningful 表示讓發現更有意義。

entries.prompt: The library extended _____ hours so students could prepare for certification exams.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: hours 前需要所有格 its，指 library 的開放時間。

entries.prompt: Employees _____ completed the January refresher do not need to attend the session again.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: 先行詞 Employees 是人，且關係子句缺主詞，因此用 who。

entries.prompt: Please submit the attendance list by Friday _____ the compliance office can update its records.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: so that 表示目的：提交名單，以便更新紀錄。

entries.prompt: The east driveway is slightly _____ from the elevators than the regular shuttle pickup area.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: than 表示比較，slightly 修飾比較級 farther。

entries.prompt: The app allows residents _____ damaged sidewalks by uploading a photograph and location marker.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: allow + object + to V，表示允許居民回報。

entries.prompt: Requests missing a project code will be returned _____ correction.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: returned for correction 表示退回以便修正。

entries.prompt: The association reviews privacy notices _____ to ensure that stores describe their sensors accurately.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: 修飾 reviews 需用副詞 periodically。

entries.prompt: The manager asked _____ the online training sessions had to be reserved in advance.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: asked 後接 whether 引導的名詞子句，表示是否需要預約。

entries.prompt: A clearly _____ button replaced the swipe gesture in the final version of the app.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: button 需要形容詞修飾，clearly labeled button 表示標示清楚的按鈕。

entries.prompt: The online session is available only to employees _____ remotely on the day of training.
entries.promptZh: 請依句意與文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
entries.explanation: employees working remotely 是現在分詞片語修飾 employees，表示當天遠端工作的員工。

entries.prompt: Employees _____ at remote construction sites must complete the safety module before arrival.
entries.promptZh: 在偏遠工地工作的員工必須在抵達前完成安全課程。
entries.explanation: working at remote construction sites 是 who work at remote construction sites 的省略形式。employees 主動在工地工作，因此使用現在分詞 working。

entries.prompt: The mobile application, _____ in March, now supports biometric sign-in.
entries.promptZh: 這款於三月推出的行動應用程式現在支援生物辨識登入。
entries.explanation: launched in March 省略了 which was launched in March。application 是被推出，使用過去分詞 launched。

entries.prompt: Once _____ by the legal department, the agreement will be sent to the client.
entries.promptZh: 協議一經法務部核准，就會寄給客戶。
entries.explanation: Once approved 省略了 Once it is approved。agreement 與 approve 是被動關係，因此用過去分詞 approved。

entries.prompt: _____ within walking distance of the convention center, the hotel is popular with exhibitors.
entries.promptZh: 這家飯店位於會議中心步行可達之處，因此很受參展商歡迎。
entries.explanation: the hotel is located... 為被動狀態，句首省略主詞與 be 動詞後使用 Located。

entries.prompt: Customers _____ to participate in the beta test will receive setup instructions by e-mail.
entries.promptZh: 受邀參加測試版試用的顧客將透過電子郵件收到設定說明。
entries.explanation: invited to participate 省略了 who are invited to participate。customers 是被邀請的對象，因此用過去分詞 invited。

entries.prompt: While _____ the replacement battery, the technician noticed a damaged connector.
entries.promptZh: 技術人員安裝替換電池時，注意到一個受損的接頭。
entries.explanation: While installing 省略了 While the technician was installing。technician 主動安裝電池，因此用現在分詞 installing。

entries.prompt: Unless _____ otherwise in writing, all quotations remain valid for thirty days.
entries.promptZh: 除非另有書面說明，所有報價的有效期均為三十天。
entries.explanation: Unless stated otherwise 省略了 Unless it is stated otherwise，是正式商務文件常見的被動省略句。

entries.prompt: The files _____ in the encrypted folder can be accessed only by project leaders.
entries.promptZh: 儲存在加密資料夾中的檔案只有專案主管可以存取。
entries.explanation: stored in the encrypted folder 省略了 that are stored...。files 是被儲存，因此使用過去分詞 stored。

entries.prompt: When _____ on a tablet, the dashboard automatically rearranges its panels.
entries.promptZh: 儀表板在平板上檢視時，會自動重新排列面板。
entries.explanation: When viewed on a tablet 省略了 When it is viewed on a tablet。dashboard 是被觀看，使用過去分詞 viewed。

entries.prompt: The auditor recommended that each branch _____ its access records every quarter.
entries.promptZh: 稽核員建議每間分公司每季檢查其存取紀錄。
entries.explanation: recommend that + 主詞 + 原形動詞是要求／建議類假設語氣，因此使用 review，不隨主詞 each branch 加 -s。

entries.prompt: It is essential that backup copies _____ in a location separate from the main server.
entries.promptZh: 備份副本必須存放在與主伺服器不同的位置。
entries.explanation: It is essential that... 後使用原形假設語氣；copies 與 store 是被動關係，所以用 be stored。

entries.prompt: Ms. Ahmed requested that the vendor _____ the delivery schedule before noon.
entries.promptZh: Ahmed 女士要求供應商在中午前修訂交貨時程。
entries.explanation: request that + 主詞 + 原形動詞，表示正式要求，因此使用 revise。

entries.prompt: It is vital that every access request _____ by two supervisors.
entries.promptZh: 每項存取申請都必須由兩名主管核准。
entries.explanation: It is vital that... 後用原形假設語氣；request 是被核准，故為 be approved。

entries.prompt: The consultant suggested that the launch date _____ until the security review was complete.
entries.promptZh: 顧問建議將上線日期延後到安全審查完成後。
entries.explanation: suggest that... 採原形假設語氣；launch date 與 postpone 是被動關係，因此使用 be postponed。

entries.prompt: The policy requires that no visitor _____ unattended in the laboratory.
entries.promptZh: 政策要求任何訪客都不得在實驗室內無人陪同。
entries.explanation: require that + 主詞 + 原形動詞，因此 no visitor 後仍使用 remain。

entries.prompt: If the prototype _____ more reliable, the company would demonstrate it at the trade fair.
entries.promptZh: 如果這個原型更可靠，公司就會在商展中展示它。
entries.explanation: 主句 would demonstrate 表示與現在情況相反或可能性低的假設；be 動詞正式使用 were。

entries.prompt: The manager asked that the confidential draft _____ after the meeting.
entries.promptZh: 經理要求會議結束後銷毀機密草稿。
entries.explanation: ask that... 表正式要求，後接原形假設語氣；draft 是被銷毀，故選 be destroyed。

entries.prompt: It was proposed that the unused office _____ into a customer training room.
entries.promptZh: 有人提議將閒置辦公室改建成顧客培訓室。
entries.explanation: It was proposed that... 後採原形假設語氣；office 是被改建，因此用 be converted。

entries.prompt: _____ the revised budget, the committee approved the project without further discussion.
entries.promptZh: 審閱修訂後的預算後，委員會未再討論便核准了專案。
entries.explanation: 先審閱預算，之後才核准專案。Having + p.p. 表示分詞構句的動作早於主句，因此選 Having reviewed。

entries.prompt: Not _____ the building's access code, the courier called the reception desk.
entries.promptZh: 由於不知道大樓門禁密碼，快遞員打電話給接待櫃台。
entries.explanation: courier 主動知道／不知道密碼，否定分詞構句用 Not knowing。

entries.prompt: _____ for high-volume transactions, the new payment system can process requests within seconds.
entries.promptZh: 這套新付款系統專為大量交易設計，可在數秒內處理請求。
entries.explanation: payment system 是被設計來處理大量交易，使用過去分詞 Designed 作被動分詞構句。

entries.prompt: _____ with the previous model, the updated scanner uses considerably less power.
entries.promptZh: 與前一款相比，更新後的掃描器耗電量明顯較低。
entries.explanation: Compared with... 是固定的被動分詞片語，表示「與……相比」。scanner 是被拿來比較的對象。

entries.prompt: _____ the encrypted portal, employees can submit expense documents from any branch.
entries.promptZh: 員工可使用加密入口網站，從任何分公司提交費用文件。
entries.explanation: employees 主動使用 portal，且使用與提交同時發生，因此用現在分詞 Using。

entries.prompt: _____ of the route change in advance, the driver avoided the closed bridge.
entries.promptZh: 司機事先收到路線變更通知，因此避開了封閉的橋梁。
entries.explanation: driver 先被通知，之後避開封閉橋梁。用 Having been + p.p. 同時表達先發生與被動。

entries.prompt: _____ with an unexpected shortage, the manufacturer contacted two alternative suppliers.
entries.promptZh: 面臨突發短缺，製造商聯絡了兩家替代供應商。
entries.explanation: be faced with 是「面臨」的固定結構，省略 be 後成為 Faced with...。

entries.prompt: _____ on three years of usage data, the forecast predicts a steady increase in demand.
entries.promptZh: 這項預測以三年的使用資料為基礎，預計需求將穩定成長。
entries.explanation: the forecast is based on data，省略 be 動詞後使用 Based on...。forecast 與 base 是被動關係。

entries.prompt: _____ all required safety checks, the engineers authorized the system restart.
entries.promptZh: 完成所有必要的安全檢查後，工程師核准重新啟動系統。
entries.explanation: 工程師先完成檢查，才授權重新啟動。Having completed 清楚表示先後順序。

entries.prompt: The new routing system will not only reduce delivery time but also _____ fuel efficiency.
entries.promptZh: 新的路線系統不僅會縮短配送時間，也會提高燃油效率。
entries.explanation: not only reduce... but also improve... 要保持原形動詞平行，因此選 improve。

entries.prompt: The coordinator is responsible for scheduling interviews, monitoring attendance, and _____ final reports.
entries.promptZh: 協調員負責安排面試、追蹤出席情況及準備最終報告。
entries.explanation: 介系詞 for 後的三項工作為 scheduling、monitoring、preparing，必須保持 V-ing 平行。

entries.prompt: The revised dashboard is both accurate and _____ to interpret.
entries.promptZh: 修訂後的儀表板既準確又容易解讀。
entries.explanation: both A and B 連接相同語法角色；accurate 是形容詞，因此 B 也用形容詞 easy。

entries.prompt: Applicants may either upload the certificate online or _____ a printed copy in person.
entries.promptZh: 申請人可以在線上上傳證書，或親自提交紙本。
entries.explanation: either upload... or submit... 連接兩個原形動詞，故使用 submit。

entries.prompt: The initiative aims to shorten waiting times, reduce paperwork, and _____ customer satisfaction.
entries.promptZh: 這項計畫旨在縮短等候時間、減少文書作業並提高顧客滿意度。
entries.explanation: aims to 後接三個平行原形動詞：shorten、reduce、improve。

entries.prompt: The new approval process is faster than the previous one and _____ to audit.
entries.promptZh: 新的核准流程比舊流程更快，也更容易稽核。
entries.explanation: faster 與 easier 都是比較級形容詞，平行描述 new approval process。

entries.prompt: The board will decide whether the company renews the lease or _____ to a smaller office.
entries.promptZh: 董事會將決定公司要續租，還是搬到較小的辦公室。
entries.explanation: whether A or B 連接兩個子句；前半是 the company renews，後半省略相同主詞後仍需第三人稱單數 relocates。

entries.prompt: The role requires preparing budgets, negotiating contracts, and _____ vendor performance.
entries.promptZh: 這個職位需要編製預算、洽談合約及評估供應商表現。
entries.explanation: requires 後列舉三項工作，preparing、negotiating、evaluating 必須保持 V-ing 平行。

entries.prompt: The report was praised for its clear organization, concise language, and _____ recommendations.
entries.promptZh: 這份報告因組織清楚、語言精簡及建議實用而受到肯定。
entries.explanation: clear、concise、practical 都是形容詞，分別修飾 organization、language、recommendations，形成平行名詞片語。

entries.prompt: Employees may access the research database remotely _____ they complete the new security training.
entries.promptZh: 員工只要完成新的資安訓練，就可以遠端存取研究資料庫。
entries.explanation: provided that 後接完整子句，表示「條件是、只要」。despite 後面須接名詞或動名詞，不能直接接 they complete。

entries.prompt: _____ of the revised reporting requirement, the regional offices updated their templates before Friday.
entries.promptZh: 各地辦公室在得知修訂後的報告規定後，於星期五前更新了範本。
entries.explanation: 各地辦公室是「被通知」新規定，且通知先於更新範本，因此使用完成式被動分詞構句 Having been informed。

entries.prompt: The audit team reviewed each automated recommendation _____ before approving the final report.
entries.promptZh: 稽核團隊在核准最終報告前，逐一獨立審查每項自動化建議。
entries.explanation: 空格修飾動詞 reviewed，應使用副詞 independently，表示每項建議都經過獨立審查。

entries.prompt: Neither the raw sensor data nor the summary generated from it _____ sufficient for the safety review.
entries.promptZh: 原始感測資料和由它產生的摘要，都不足以用於安全審查。
entries.explanation: neither A nor B 的動詞通常與較近主詞一致；較近的 summary 是單數，因此使用 is。

entries.prompt: _____ the vendor disclosed the licensing restriction earlier, the committee would have selected a different platform.
entries.promptZh: 如果供應商早一點揭露授權限制，委員會就會選擇不同的平台。
entries.explanation: 這是與過去事實相反的第三類條件句倒裝：Had + 主詞 + 過去分詞，相當於 If the vendor had disclosed。

entries.prompt: The revised checklist is intended not only to identify missing permits but also to _____ whether each permit remains valid.
entries.promptZh: 修訂後的清單不僅用於找出缺少的許可證，也用於確認每張許可證是否仍有效。
entries.explanation: not only to identify ... but also to verify 應維持不定詞平行；第二個 to 可保留，空格填原形 verify。

entries.prompt: The revised reimbursement policy, together with its supporting examples, _____ available on the employee portal.
entries.promptZh: 修訂後的報銷政策及其補充範例可在員工入口網站查看。
entries.explanation: together with its supporting examples 是插入補充語，不改變主詞；真正主詞 policy 為單數，故用 is。

entries.prompt: The compliance officer recommended that a copy of every approval record _____ for at least five years.
entries.promptZh: 法遵主管建議每份核准紀錄的副本至少保留五年。
entries.explanation: recommend that 後的名詞子句使用原形假設語氣；record 是被保留，因此用被動原形 be retained。
